name: electralens
description: Independent, open-methodology electoral-roll transparency platform. Not affiliated with the Election Commission of India.

scripts.engine:lint: uv run --directory services/engine ruff check . && uv run --directory services/engine ruff format --check .
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm engine:lint && pnpm engine:test
scripts.db:test: npx supabase db lint --level warning --fail-on warning && npx supabase test db
